text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I visited a nature park far away
and spotted Tokai Teio and Yamanin Zephyr
at the obstacle course playground.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: My... What a wonderful place.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right, right? There are so many fun-looking
obstacles here, Zephyr! Heheh~, I've been
looking forward to this all week!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...How pleasant. A leaf-borne breeze, flowing
through the trees and across this clearing.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's what caught your eye?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh well, that's just like you anyway!
Regardless, let's have a ton of fun!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Ooh! Giant jungle gym spotted over there!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr! Since we're here, let's have a match!
Whoever touches the very top first and
comes back wins!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The heavenly winds drifting near the sky...
I would love to feel them against my skin.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Alright! Ready, set... GO!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daah! A magnificent finish! Nishishi~,
that's gotta be a new all-time record
for this park!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, huh? Zephyr, where are you?
Hellooo~?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Up here.

Tokai Teio turned toward the voice—and found
Yamanin Zephyr perched atop a tree that had
nothing to do with the jungle gym.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I felt I could take in more of the wind from here.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see... Wait, no! That wasn't
what the contest was about at all!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just as I thought, a gentle, soothing breeze—
resonating from the far reaches of the sky—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
W-What the heck~, enjoying yourself all alone like that!
Somehow I feel like I lost...! I-I'm climbing up too!

Though baffled by Yamanin Zephyr's utter lack of urgency,
Tokai Teio continued to explore the park together with her.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...... An unusual, sudden gust—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up, Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Rustling gently past my ears—
Fufu. It seems to be calling to us—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? Calling us...? Whoa, where do you think you're going?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I do not know.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You don't know?! Ugh, seriously, you're WAY too carefree!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —My. This is...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...! This place is— I was so focused on the
obstacle course, I didn't realize such a
beautiful spot existed...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—I feel it. The birth of a wind—
This is a land that beckons the breeze—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The pure breeze, the leaf-wind, the swift gusts...
they all seem to be playing harmoniously together. Fufufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I don't really get it, but it seems
like you're having a blast in your own way, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm gonna dance too! Next up is a dance battle!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu, let us become a single gust of wind together.

Though their wavelengths rarely matched, the two of them
enjoyed their time together at their own respective paces.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Alright! I won't lose either—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh? Where's Zephyr?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Another wind calls...
This time, over here—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: A-Again?! Jeez, what am I gonna do with you!
—And so, the two ran off once again into the distance.
